All features unlocked No licenses, no limitations. Every feature is now completely free. Simplified configuration Cleaner options and improved usability to speed up report design. Bug fixes and stability improvements A more reliable and performant experience. Core Features Multiple cards Connect several measures or columns to a single visual to improve performance and reduce visual clutter. Advanced states Define conditions with flexible rules to highlight performance scenarios. Dynamic label Automatically update the label based on cursor position over the trend line.
